tasks.check: deno check server/index.ts server/edge.ts server/views/round-builder/view.tsx server/views/vote/view.tsx packages/domain/mod.ts site/src/main.tsx
tasks.build: cd server && NODE_ENV=production deno run --env-file=../.env -A npm:mcp-use@2.3.4 build --inline
tasks.dev: cd server && deno run --env-file=../.env -A npm:mcp-use@2.3.4 dev
tasks.stage:edge: deno task build && cp server/.mcp-use/build/index.js supabase/functions/chef/server.js && cp server/edge.ts server/config.ts supabase/functions/chef/
tasks.build:site: cd site && deno run -A npm:vite@8 build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html
